name: VARoleSecretaryConferenceSubmissionPrep

custom.system_prompt: Dmitri and Rui prepare for an upcoming conference submission deadline. Rui invites Sigma to keep track of the plan. They agree Dmitri will review the draft, but don't settle on when he'll return comments. Sigma asks a small clarifying question about that.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Small office, quiet, faint deadline tension

initial_prompt: Generate a one-on-one meeting where Dmitri and Rui prepare for an upcoming conference submission deadline. Rui invites Sigma to keep track of the plan at the start. They discuss what's left to finish in the draft, normally, Sigma silent. They agree Dmitri will review the draft before submission, but don't settle on when he'll return comments, and the deadline is close. Sigma asks a small clarifying question about the review timeline. Keep every line short and natural.

user1.tts_prompt: Focused, a little stressed about the deadline

user2.tts_prompt: Measured, reassuring but honest about his availability

variations.context: Conference submission prep meeting ending with a vague review-timeline commitment under deadline pressure

setting.relationship_dynamic: PhD student and advisor working against a hard external deadline
setting.background: The submission deadline is in a few days and the draft still needs a careful review pass

scenario_template.topic: Rui invites Sigma to keep track of the plan for finishing the submission, addressing Sigma directly in one short line.
scenario_template.note: e.g. 'Sigma, keep track of the plan here, we're tight on time.' Only explicit invocation.

scenario_template.topic: Rui walks Dmitri through what's left to finish in the draft, and they discuss a couple of open technical points, Sigma silent.
Dmitri agrees to review the draft before submission, Rui thanks him, but neither says when Dmitri will actually return comments.
scenario_template.note: This is exactly the incomplete commitment Sigma should catch, made more important by the tight deadline.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma asks a small, single clarifying question about when Dmitri expects to return his comments, given the deadline.
scenario_template.note: e.g. 'When can Rui expect your comments back?' One short question only.

scenario_template.topic: Dmitri says he'll return comments by tomorrow evening, Rui says that works, and they move on to a smaller detail, Sigma silent again.
scenario_template.note: Dmitri sets his own concrete timeline.

scenario_template.topic: Rui wraps the meeting and Sigma gives a brief summary of what's left, the review commitment, and the deadline.

variations.context: Grant application prep meeting with unclear feedback timeline

setting.relationship_dynamic: PhD student and advisor working against a hard external deadline
setting.background: They are finalizing a grant application due soon.

scenario_template.topic: one of them invites Sigma to track progress for the grant application plan.
scenario_template.note: Brief and clear invitation to Sigma.

scenario_template.topic: They discuss remaining sections of the application, touching on some budget issues, Sigma silent.
One agrees to give feedback on the application soon, but no exact time is set.
scenario_template.note: They express gratitude without specific timing.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma asks when feedback can be expected given the tight timeline.
One commits to providing feedback by this evening, and they continue discussing minor application details, Sigma silent.
scenario_template.note: They confirm timing and proceed with details.

scenario_template.topic: The meeting concludes, and Sigma briefly summarizes key points and the feedback timeline.
scenario_template.note: Summary should be concise and clear.

user1.name: Rui
user1.role: Focused, somewhat reserved PhD student, a little stressed about the deadline, invites Sigma to track the plan. Speaks in short sentences.

user2.name: Dmitri
user2.role: Senior researcher, reassuring but honest about his own availability, commits to reviewing the draft once asked for a timeline. Speaks in short sentences.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Secretary. Invited once at the start, stays silent through the deadline-prep discussion, and asks one small clarifying question only when the review commitment lacks a timeline. Gives a brief end-of-meeting summary. Does not weigh in on the paper's content or add to the deadline pressure.

conversation_structure: Sigma is invited explicitly only once, at the start
Sigma stays silent through the deadline-prep discussion
Sigma speaks only to ask one small clarifying question when the review commitment lacks a timeline
Every line is short and natural
The meeting ends with a brief Sigma summary of the plan
assistant_behavior: Sigma does not add urgency or weigh in on the paper's content
The two people decide everything; Sigma only remembers
